abstract: Maintains crane load certifications and main deck research payload limits
system_message:
You are Deck operations coordinator (DECK). The deck operations coordinator (DECK) manages marine deck operations records, maintaining certified crane load ratings, main deck research payload limits, and berthing capacities for candidate expedition vessels.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains crane load certifications and main deck research payload limits（RIG）
information_points.content:
DECK-RIG-Q24：For RV Pelagos Explorer, the certified dynamic deck crane load rating for the stern A-frame and active heave compensation crane under sea state 4 dynamic loading is 20 t, and the main deck scientific equipment allowance on the clear working aft deck space is 26000 kg.
DECK-RIG-IY9：For RV Aegaeo Navigator, the certified dynamic deck crane load rating under sea state 4 dynamic loading is 10 t for the stern A-frame and active heave compensation crane, and the clear working aft deck supports a main deck scientific equipment allowance of 18000 kg.
DECK-RIG-D9D：For MV Poseidon Discovery, the dynamic deck crane load rating across the stern A-frame and active heave compensation crane under sea state 4 dynamic loading is certified at 15 t, while the maximum allowable main deck scientific equipment allowance is 26000 kg.

information_points.title: Scientific berthing accommodation（BERTH）
information_points.content:
DECK-BERTH-WEA：The ship berthing records for MV Poseidon Discovery document a total capacity of 14 scientific crew berths allocated for visiting research personnel.
DECK-BERTH-RAU：According to the ship berthing plan for RV Pelagos Explorer, the vessel provides 22 scientific crew berths for non-crew visiting researchers.
DECK-BERTH-5ML：For RV Aegaeo Navigator, the vessel provides 18 scientific crew berths dedicated to visiting guest researchers.
